description: Escape hatch: run an arbitrary Memberful GraphQL QUERY (read-only) against your account's /api/graphql endpoint with optional variables. Mutations are REJECTED — use the dedicated write tools or memberful_graphql for those. Useful for fields not covered by the curated read tools (e.g. member-state filters beyond active).

query.description: A GraphQL query document (must be a query, not a mutation).

name: memberful_query
title: Run a GraphQL query (read-only)
